设计意图： Mutates parent by replacing the binary high-volume regime flag with the continuous volume ratio from classify_volume_regime, capturing intensity rather than just frequency of high-volume states. The 40-day averaging window preserves the core persistence intuition while being more responsive than 60 days. This targets improved timeliness and signal granularity.

已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)), 40)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
